rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something from or found in the nearby area.

example.english: This shop specializes in local farm produce.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭專賣本地農產品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zyun1 maai6 bun2 dei6 nung4 caan2 ban2

rows.note: Use this attributive construction for something stored on or accessed directly from a particular computer or device.

example.english: These are local files that you can open without the internet.
example.traditional: 呢啲係本機嘅檔案，冇網絡都開到。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 bun2 gei1 ge3 dong2 on3 mou5 mong5 lok3 dou1 hoi1 dou2

rows.meaning: affecting one area of the body
rows.note: Use this mainly in medical or technical contexts for something restricted to one part of the body.

example.traditional: 呢種藥只係針對局部發炎。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 joek6 zi2 hai6 zam1 deoi3 guk6 bou6 faat3 jim4
